criteria.label: Search intent satisfied
criteria.guidance: 3 = answers the intent behind the frontmatter `keyword` within the first 200 words. 2 = answers it, but late or by a detour. 1 = addresses an adjacent question. 0 = does not match the intent.

criteria.label: Title and description
criteria.guidance: 2 = keyword present, title <= 60 chars, description <= 155 chars, no duplicated phrasing between them. 1 = one of those violated. 0 = two or more. Note: layout.js appends ' | Gluten-Free Korea' at render time — count it.

criteria.label: Heading structure and scannability
criteria.guidance: 2 = headings describe content rather than label it, and a reader skimming only the headings gets the argument. 1 = structured but generic headings. 0 = wall of text or misleading headings.

criteria.label: Internal links
criteria.guidance: 2 = at least 3 contextually earned internal links. 1 = 1-2. 0 = none. Links stuffed where they do not help the reader score as 0 regardless of count.

criteria.label: FAQ / structured-data alignment
criteria.guidance: 2 = every frontmatter `faq` Q/A is supported by the body and stands alone if shown as a rich result. 1 = partially. 0 = an answer asserts something the body never establishes. Google requires markup to match visible content.

criteria.label: Experience (first-hand)
criteria.guidance: 3 = specific observed facts: dates, places, quantities, things that went wrong. 2 = concrete but thin. 1 = general advice anyone could write. 0 = no signal of first-hand experience.

criteria.label: Expertise (specificity)
criteria.guidance: 2 = product names, Korean terms with romanisation, and figures stated precisely enough that a reader could check them. 1 = partially specific. 0 = vague throughout.

criteria.label: Authoritativeness (sourcing)
criteria.guidance: 2 = primary sources linked with their publication dates. 1 = sources present but undated. 0 = claims with no attribution.

criteria.label: Trust (limits and disclosure)
criteria.guidance: 2 = the piece states what its method cannot establish, and any affiliate link is disclosed. 1 = one of those missing. 0 = overclaims, or an undisclosed commercial link.
